CheckTitle: Apps are assigned to groups, not directly to end users
Description: Checks active apps use group assignments and avoid direct user assignments.
Risk: Direct app assignments increase access sprawl and make access review harder.

Code.Other:
1. In the Okta Admin Console, go to Applications > Applications.
2. Open the affected app and select the Assignments tab.
3. Create or select a group that represents the users who need the app.
4. Assign the app to the group and confirm the expected users receive access.
5. Remove direct user assignments after group-based assignment is in place.

Recommendation.Text: Use group assignments for applications so access can be reviewed and changed centrally.

Notes: Requires the Okta read scopes documented for the referenced management APIs.
